item.title: We Don't Want More Apps
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers We Don’t Want More Apps I open the App Store and a red number is waiting for me: 70 pending updates. I didn’t ask for them. I don’t know what they change. I couldn’t review them one by one even if I wanted to. And it hasn’t been that long since the last time — a week, maybe two. Think about it for a moment and it’s absurd.

item.title: Video Real-Time Communications Endpoints
item.description: Photo source: Interactive Powers Real-Time communication technology represents a qualitative leap in any communication process. One of the most outstanding advantages is VideoRTC. But what platforms can we use to benefit from this innovative technology? Web browsers, mobile devices and interactive kiosks are the main endpoints from which to interact in real time. Web Browsers. Browsers are still the most important terminals from which to access the Internet when it comes to everyday work.
